codex.name: The summons under the forms
codex.text: A small square paper nailed below Darrow's writ on a bell-post on the mill tracks, a nail in each corner spaced to the hair, in an upright hand with every letter cut like a stroke and no name under it: the captain of the Ninth who walks with a stick to come to the weir below the mill at the end of the tracks, at first light on the second morning, alone, under the forms, to answer a question (Ch 6 Sc 5).

codex.name: The forms of a knight's meeting
codex.text: When one knight sends for another under the forms, each comes alone; the one who sends names the ground and the one who comes chooses where on it he stands; a question is asked before any blade is drawn, and nobody on the bank lifts a hand while it is answered. Ser Hollis Garrow, at the fire (Ch 6 Sc 5).

now.against: A duelist who has sent for him under the forms, to the weir below the mill, alone, at first light on the second morning.
